title: NLTK: Uncontrolled recursion in Toolbox settings helpers causes denial of service via deeply nested input…
description: NLTK's Toolbox settings helpers contain uncontrolled recursion when processing deeply nested input, leading to a denial of service via unhandled RecursionError. The recursion depth is unbounded in several helper functions that traverse the parsed element tree, allowing an attacker to cause application termination by supplying deeply nested settings files. The flaw does not affect confidentiality or integrity. A fix bounding recursion depth was merged but not yet released as of the latest data.
